name: GAN i4 MagLev Frosted 3x3 (Smart Cube)
description: Introducing the GAN i4 MagLev Frosted 3x3 — the latest evolution in GAN’s line of flagship smartcubes. Built for speedcubers who refuse to compromise, the i4 brings a perfect blend of lightning-fast performance and intelligent tracking technology, wrapped in GAN’s classic matte frosted finish.
features: Effortless Disassembly & Setup: Unique 6-color ball core makes reassembly straightforward and stress-free, always guaranteeing perfect alignment with the app.
Featherlight, Competition-Ready: Weighing just 74g, the i4 offers effortless, fatigue-free handling — ideal for those marathon sessions or heated competitions.
